sources.title: EMA Enflonsia product information, June 2026
sources.locator: Sections 4.1–4.8 and 5.1–5.2, physical pages 2–10; authorisation section 9
sources.check_performed: Independently read indication, single-dose passive mechanism, safety and trial methods. Main hospital endpoint efficacy 84.2% (95% CI 66.6–92.6).
